title: Eigenius: A Typed Knowledge-Graph DBMS with Epistemic Stratification and Institution-Mediated Reasoning
title_zh: Eigenius：具备认知分层与机构中介推理的类型化知识图谱 DBMS
abstract_en: As "AI Scientists" emerge to drive research via the Model Context Protocol (MCP), systems relying on ephemeral scripts will fail. The sheer scale of stateful, interconnected evidence requires a machine-walkable warranty grounded in a purpose-built database architecture. Eigenius is an open-source, typed knowledge-graph DBMS built on a single premise: answering the audit question ("what do you know, and what is your warranty?") requires a unified kernel. By tightly coupling the type system, storage engine, and integration protocol, Eigenius turns data provenance into a structural invariant rather than a property reconstructed across subsystem boundaries. The kernel rests on three pillars: a dependent type theory woven through the core, institutions acting as strongly typed integration boundaries, and a content-addressed immutable storage layer. On this foundation, epistemic status (declared/observed/derived/verified) is enforced as a strict commit-time invariant. Cross-system translations (comorphisms) are checked at commit and materialized directly into the graph as durable, first-class resources. To eliminate O(N^2) polystore bottlenecks, shared on-chain intermediate representations (IRs) collapse multi-system translations to identity. Crucially, this architecture unifies both domains of scientific epistemology: it relies on justification logic for empirical science, while embedding a fast, in-process term checker to safely evaluate formal mathematical proofs (via Lean 4) without IPC overhead. In an end-to-end recomputation of a published Nature study from fragile scripts to a materialized evidence graph, all 52 derived conclusions hold from pinned data, surfacing four machine-checked discrepancies in the original study.
abstract_zh: Eigenius 是一个开源的类型化知识图谱数据库管理系统（DBMS），面向由 AI Scientists 和 Model Context Protocol（MCP）驱动的科研自动化场景。论文认为，依赖临时脚本的系统难以支撑大规模、有状态、相互关联的科学证据管理；科研系统必须能够回答“你知道什么，以及你的保证依据是什么？”这一审计问题。Eigenius 通过统一类型系统、存储引擎和集成协议，将数据溯源从跨子系统事后重建的属性，提升为数据库内核的结构性不变量。其核心由三部分构成：嵌入内核的依赖类型理论、作为强类型集成边界的 institutions，以及内容寻址的不可变存储层。系统在提交时强制维护认知状态（declared/observed/derived/verified）不变量，并将跨系统翻译（comorphisms）检查后物化为图中的一等持久资源。为避免多存储系统中的 O(N^2) 翻译瓶颈，Eigenius 使用共享链上中间表示（IR）将多系统翻译退化为恒等映射。同时，它结合 justification logic 支持经验科学证据论证，并内嵌 Lean 4 项检查器以低开销验证形式化数学证明。论文在复现一篇 Nature 研究时，将脆弱脚本转换为物化证据图，验证了全部 52 个派生结论，并发现原研究中 4 处机器可检查的不一致。
key_points_zh: 提出 Eigenius：一个将类型系统、存储引擎和集成协议紧耦合的开源 typed knowledge-graph DBMS，用于支撑 AI Scientists 场景下的大规模科研证据管理。
将数据 provenance 设计为内核级结构不变量，并在 commit-time 强制检查 declared、observed、derived、verified 等 epistemic status。
使用 institutions 作为强类型系统集成边界，跨系统 comorphisms 在提交时验证，并作为持久一等资源物化进知识图谱。
通过共享 on-chain IR 避免 polystore 中多系统两两转换导致的 O(N^2) 瓶颈，将部分翻译简化为 identity。
同时支持经验科学与形式数学：前者基于 justification logic，后者通过进程内 Lean 4 term checker 安全验证证明；在 Nature 研究复现中确认 52 个结论并发现 4 处不一致。

llm_assessment.comment: Eigenius proposes durable provenance infrastructure relevant to auditable agentic science, but it is closer to a knowledge-graph DBMS than an agent harness.
llm_assessment.comment_zh: Eigenius 提出了与可审计智能体科学相关的持久溯源基础设施，但更接近知识图谱数据库而非智能体运行框架。
